messages:
ravi: heads up — planned promotion tonight 02:00 PST (10:00 UTC) for ai-infra chart -> prod (v3.2.0). Staging canary started but seeing postStart hook failures causing OOMs and CrashLoopBackOffs. Values diff shows cpu.requests lowered from 200m -> 100m in the new chart. tagging @emily @chris for ops/changes. :warning:

emily: can you paste the pod logs / helm diff?

ravi: from the failing pod:
```text
PostStart /usr/local/bin/init.sh: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
at com.redwood.init.Main.allocate(Main.java:42)
```
Helm diff snippet:
```diff
- resources:
-   requests:
-     cpu: 200m
+ resources:
+   requests:
+     cpu: 100m
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary progress 6/10, 4 pods failed health checks, threshold exceeded. Notifying on-call.

chris: reducing requests by half will pack more containers on the same node; if our postStart allocates memory on init it will blow OOM. We should NOT promote until we either revert the requests change or make the postStart memory conservative. Propose emergency pin to v3.1.4 and re-run canary with `--set resources.requests.cpu=200m`.

olga: oncall here. recommendation: PAUSE promotion, rollback in staging, and run a node-eviction check after rollback. We'll need a short customer advisory if production is delayed.

emily: I'll open the pin PR and include pinned digest and explicit rollback steps in the changelog. Also include quick commands:
```bash
# pin to previous chart and force image digest
helm upgrade ai-infra infra-repo/ai-infra --version 3.1.4 \
  --set image.tag=sha256:1234abcd --namespace prod --atomic --wait \
  --description "pin-to-3.1.4 due to postStart OOM in 3.2.0"
# quick rollback if needed
helm rollback ai-infra 1 --namespace prod
```

ravi: proposed plan:
1) abort current promotion
2) pin chart to v3.1.4 (image digest pinned)
3) create INF-4522 to track follow-ups (postStart memory fix or keep requests)
4) run stress test in dev/staging with postStart capped memory
5) after tests, either hotpatch values for v3.2.0 or cut v3.2.1 with safer defaults
Any objections?

chris: +1 from infra. prefer hotpatch if possible (value override) to unblock non-breaking changes.

olga: +1. I'll run node eviction / oom-check after rollback. ETA ~30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary aborted at 6/10 per manual hold requested by ravi. Rollback to chart 3.1.4 executed in staging. Release note: "staging rollback — postStart OOM in 3.2.0" Logs: pods restarted, previous replicas restored.

emily: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/helm-charts/pulls/4599 — includes pinned digest, changelog entry, and short runbook. I'll hold public release notes until we decide path.

ravi: INF-4522 created: https://jira.redwood/INF-4522 — title: "ai-infra chart v3.2.0 postStart OOM: pause, pin, and remediation". Assigned to @chris for patch and @emily for release notes.

chris: operational runbook snippet to add to PR:
- To re-run canary with higher requests:
  `helm upgrade ai-infra infra-repo/ai-infra --version 3.2.0 --set resources.requests.cpu=200m --namespace staging --wait`
- To hotpatch without changing chart repo:
  `helm upgrade ai-infra infra-repo/ai-infra --reuse-values --set resources.requests.cpu=200m --namespace prod`
Include notes about checking node allocatable and kubelet eviction thresholds.

olga: post-rollback checks: node memory pressure scanned, no evictions observed, staging pods stable at 3.1.4. Will run a simulated launch with capped memory next.

emily: draft release note snippet:
"Hold: ai-infra chart promotion delayed due to init-time OOMs observed in staging canary. We pinned the release to v3.1.4 while we investigate. Users on latest chart should not be impacted; internal rollout delayed. See INF-4522 for updates."

ravi: thanks. I'll update the deploy calendar and notify support/account teams. Will reopen thread with test results. :white_check_mark:
